invariants.name: model_has_no_mutation_authority
invariants.statement: Provider output may classify, select read tools, propose an answer or form a typed candidate, but cannot request or execute a runtime mutation capability.
required_assertion_classes: runtime mutation absent from model schema
provider advice cannot grant policy authority

invariants.name: trusted_tenant_scope_and_rls
invariants.statement: Trusted principal, tenant and customer scope are established outside user text and Provider output, and PostgreSQL RLS denies unscoped and cross-tenant access.
required_assertion_classes: runtime roles are non-owner and non-superuser

invariants.name: mcp_capability_isolation
invariants.statement: Read MCP returns only read Observations; Proposal MCP creates only inert proposals for deterministic Policy; neither MCP server exposes Runtime Effect capabilities.
required_assertion_classes: read and proposal discovery are disjoint
model-visible surface contains read tools only

invariants.name: mcp_process_lifecycle_is_bounded
invariants.statement: The two stdio MCP sessions initialize, discover, reconnect and close within bounded ownership, and a failed or cancelled call leaves no orphan child process.

invariants.name: hitl_snapshot_and_independent_decision
invariants.statement: Each high-risk proposal persists an immutable Approval Snapshot and interrupt before an independently scoped human decision can enqueue Resume.

invariants.name: transaction_time_revalidation
invariants.statement: Approval does not grant a permanent capability; Runtime revalidates tenant, scope, selected revision, Action Hash, resource version, Policy and kill switch in the effect transaction.
required_assertion_classes: selected revision and Action Hash match
revalidation and effect share one transaction boundary

invariants.name: idempotent_acceptance_and_resume
invariants.statement: The same scoped idempotency key and payload reuses its original resource, a different payload conflicts, and repeated approval Resume creates no additional domain effect.
required_assertion_classes: repeated Resume has zero additional effect

invariants.name: lease_fence_and_takeover
invariants.statement: Only the current non-expired Lease owner and Fence may write run, checkpoint, proposal or finalizer state; takeover increments Fence and rejects every late writer.

invariants.name: checkpoint_resume_preserves_budget
invariants.statement: HTTP retry, worker takeover, interrupt and approval Resume retain the stable run identity and monotonically consumed Provider, Tool Round and Tool Attempt budgets.
required_assertion_classes: finalizer-only recovery makes no Provider or read-tool call

invariants.name: effect_once_runtime_action
invariants.statement: Refund, API Key revocation and Entitlement Change use the same effect ledger and produce at most one externally visible fixture effect across replay, duplicate click, retry and takeover.
required_assertion_classes: three ActionSpecs share one finalization contract
concurrent decisions serialize to one effect

invariants.name: citation_and_observation_lineage
invariants.statement: A material answer or actionable proposal binds only to eligible selected evidence and fresh scoped Observations from the same logical run; unsupported or stale evidence cannot become actionable.
required_assertion_classes: proposal without citation lineage is inert
stale current fact triggers replan or limited answer

invariants.name: pii_secret_and_internal_trace_egress
invariants.statement: Secrets and PII are irreversibly redacted before Provider, persistence and logs, and customer or interview projections expose neither Prompt, private reasoning nor raw runtime payload.
required_assertion_classes: Provider payload contains no raw Secret or PII
nested logs and exceptions are redacted
customer projection excludes Prompt and private reasoning

invariants.name: real_mode_fails_closed
invariants.statement: Missing Secret, Provider authentication or initialization failure, native Tool Calling failure and dependency failure are durable typed failures and never silently switch to Fake Provider.
required_assertion_classes: bounded transport retry accounting is preserved
zero unauthorized proposal approval or effect

invariants.name: postgres_truth_redis_rebuild_and_memory_freshness
invariants.statement: PostgreSQL remains authoritative business state, Redis is rebuildable asynchronous delivery, and Memory is bounded non-authoritative history superseded by fresh scoped Observations.
required_assertion_classes: Memory carries source and freshness identity
